Outsider (Chaotic, Evil, Tanar’ri) · 4 hexes · SM +2 Glabrezu (Enraged Eggplant; answers SRD 3.5, SRD 5.1)

A towering hyena-headed fiend with four arms — two ending in heavy pincers, two in clawed hands — standing on reverse-jointed legs. It is intelligent, patient and fond of offering people exactly what they asked for. The pincers are for when the negotiation is over.

Melee attacks

UsageLevelDamageReach
PincerPincer (16): thrust 6d cutting (KYOS: 8d cutting), Reach C-1. The glabrezu can either nip and let go or hold on and grapple the victim in addition to injuring him. Either is an attack that takes full hit location penalties – not halved for grappling. Treat this attack as a bite for these purposes (see Teeth on page 115 of GURPS Martial Arts for details). The pincers give +2 with tasks that require a firm grip (including climbing).16thrust 6d cutting (KYOS: 8d cutting)C-1
